1.3.1 (49) — expanded Go course and worked interview preparation.

34 new readings and 40 new interview guides. Course: 220 teaching lessons, including 173 readings, plus 22 prediction challenges across 28 units. Interview: 132 guides in 15 topics. Existing completion, mistakes, self-assessments, editable lesson drafts and Continue IDs are retained.

Around Go now includes six Gin lessons, seven blockchain-infrastructure lessons and four service-security lessons. Study middleware/Abort, input budgets, pooled contexts, trusted proxies, errors and shutdown; Ethereum/Bitcoin/Cosmos package roles, exact units, ABI, nonces, signer boundaries and reorg-safe indexing; object authorization, cryptographic purposes, SSRF/egress and TLS trust. These readings do not add a wallet, public RPC, GopherForge accounts or guest networking. Full upstream SDK/Gin examples target your native development environment; the app preview retains its existing teaching adapter.

Architecture & clean code expands to four units and 40 lessons. New material covers transaction ownership, outbox/inbox, sagas and unknown outcomes, mixed-version rollout, tenant isolation, observability, gRPC/Protobuf, Kafka offsets, partition contracts, composition and dependency lifetime, context ownership and exact time/money units.

Additional concurrency/I/O preparation covers immutable atomic publication, copying locks, timer ownership, bounded HTTP responses, cancellation barriers and partial Writer results. Four new worked algorithm guides cover sort stability/contracts, iterative directed-cycle detection, linked-list cycle entry and rendezvous hashing. The existing 12 interactive algorithm labs / 36 cases remain.

Existing make/new wording now includes Go 1.26 expression operands. Generic-method material follows Go 1.27, including the interface-method restriction. Broken reference paths were repaired. Four course readings and eight interview guides about working with coding agents remain available.

Verification: 43 native model/UI checks passed, including saved drafts, Continue and independent interview marks; 40 new complete examples ran under native Go 1.27.3 with pinned QA dependencies and local-only HTTP mocks; all 92 complete reading programs compiled; existing algorithm properties passed with the race detector. 27 web checks passed. This is not a complete app regression or physical airplane-mode certification. The bundled compiler remains Go 1.27.1. Offline npm/React, source debugging and source-recovery features from 1.3.0 remain unchanged.
